name: app-starter-template
purpose: Canonical AI-readable starter source for guiding repository creation, populating newly created empty application repositories, guiding deployment, and continued maintenance.

deploymentPolicy.instruction: First provide concrete GitHub repository creation settings. After the user provides the empty repository URL, complete the bootstrap protocol, infer the required composition, populate the starter and handoff files, and implement application-specific features. If deployment is required, inspect the actual repository configuration before giving concrete Cloudflare settings. Do not ask the user to use GitHub's Use this template flow unless they explicitly prefer it.

selectionPolicy.instruction: Infer the required template composition from the application requirements. Always start with core and add only the extensions actually needed.

rules.cloudflare-worker: Add when server-side HTTP/API processing or Cloudflare Worker functionality is required.
rules.d1: Add when Cloudflare D1 persistence is required. Also apply cloudflare-worker.
rules.sheets-gas: Add when Google Sheets or Google Apps Script integration is required.
